text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated errors on /v1/decode-stream (serving-cluster-prod-3). Symptoms: GPU OOMs, container restarts, dropped streaming responses. P95 latency spike. Auto-alert triggered at 1977654200. Paging eng oncall.

jordan: seeing a big spike in OOMs from the decode nodes. Logs show repeated CUDA OOM during decode loop, starting ~1977654100. A bunch of clients saw truncated/closed connections.

mika: I'm on it — joining. any recent deploys to streaming runtime?

samir: no deploys to runtime in last hour. There was a config push to the proxy that changed max_tokens default for streaming routes very recently (approved earlier today). Could be client-side runaway or new prompts.

jordan: logs from node-3:  

```
[2026-09-12T17:03:15Z] ERROR: decode_loop: cuda runtime error (out of memory) : out of memory at /workspace/runtime/decode.cc:418
[2026-09-12T17:03:15Z] INFO: dumping KV cache stats: tokens_cached=0 active_batches=8 seq_len=2048
[2026-09-12T17:03:16Z] WARN: container restart triggered by OOM

```

mika: seq_len=2048 + active batches 8 — that looks like a runaway generation. Are clients sending max_new_tokens or setting very large max_total?

samir: I grabbed a few sample requests from the error window — they include user-supplied max_tokens values up to 10000 (tl;dr bad clients). We have a config gap: proxy allowed unbounded max_tokens for streaming route.

devops-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply emergency throttle on decode-stream route to cap max_tokens to 1024; 2) enable model fallback to redwood-4b-quant for heavy streams to reduce memory; 3) scale up ephemeral pool to soak current queue while we roll config. I'll execute 1 and 2 now.

eva: tagging customer-success and product to notify affected customers. cs-bot: please compile impacted client list.

cs-bot: Noted — preliminary impact: ~12.4k requests dropped/closed in the window 1977654000-1977654300. Top affected orgs: AcmeCorp, NotebookCloud, Queryly. Sending followup with timestamps.

mika: executing emergency proxy change: setting STREAM_MAX_TOKENS=1024 and per-route override for /v1/decode-stream. Command: 

```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/configs/proxy" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/decode-stream","overrides":{"max_tokens":1024}}'
```

mika: change applied, now waiting for propagation (~30s).

jordan: monitoring — OOMs on node-3 dropping. New errors show fewer OOMs but still some spikes as existing heavy sessions drain.

```
[2026-09-12T17:05:02Z] INFO: applied override for /v1/decode-stream -> max_tokens=1024
[2026-09-12T17:05:20Z] INFO: routing heavy sessions to redwood-4b-quant fallback pool
```

samir: enabling automatic KV cache eviction for sessions with seq_len > 512 to free memory while we stabilize. Patch pushed to runtime config.

eva: heads-up — CS will email top affected customers with an incident note and mitigation ETA.

mika: rolling restart on the busiest decode pods to clear flawed KV cache state. Doing a 3-node rolling restart with 30s stagger.

jordan: after restart + throttle + fallback the error rate dropped ~88% within 5 minutes. Some residual retries still fail from earlier long-running sessions.

cs-bot: provisional customer impact summary: 12.4k failed requests, ~3.1k requests retried successfully, estimated ~9.3k unique user calls impacted. No data exfiltration, all errors were service-level drops (socket closed / stream aborted).

devops-oncall: handoff plan — I'm taking initial containment, handing to @eva for post-incident recovery and postmortem. Handoff summary: root cause likely unbounded client-supplied max_tokens + missing proxy enforcement -> runaway streaming sessions causing GPU OOMs and container restarts. Mitigations applied: proxy max_tokens cap, model fallback to 4b quant, KV eviction, rolling restarts. Next steps: prepare postmortem, followup customer comms, add config guardrails, add rate limit at edge.

eva: taking over. I'll coordinate the postmortem. Action items I captured: 1) add hard server-side max_tokens default + upper bound; 2) add per-org rate limiting for streaming; 3) expand telemetry for seq_len distribution; 4) add an alert for long-lived streaming sessions > 5k tokens; 5) document fallback model policy.

samir: quick note — we should also block client-specified max_tokens > 2048 at the proxy until we have more robust per-session memory accounting.

mika: Filed quick hotfix PR to add a proxy validation step (reject or truncate >2048). Will push to canary after review.

incident-bot: UPDATE: incident severity set to SEV2 (customer-impacting) at 1977654350. Pager rotation paused for this incident.

jordan: collecting flamegraphs and memory traces for the affected GPU pods, will attach to the incident ticket. Early signs show GPU memory pressure happened progressively as sessions appended tokens without truncation.

eva: assigned postmortem owner: @mika. Please include timeline, root cause analysis, config diffs, and action item owners. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

cs-bot: CS draft going out to AcmeCorp + NotebookCloud now with workaround steps and apology. We'll include retry guidance and note the fallback to lower-capacity model for heavy streams.

mika: can confirm hotfix PR merged to canary. Will promote to prod after quick smoke.

jordan: final state: error rate back to baseline by 1977654800. No further OOM restarts after rolling restart and throttles.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation confirmed at 1977654830. Closing page and creating followup ticket ENG-INC-1977654321 for postmortem.

eva: thanks everyone — good catch and fast mitigation. We'll keep the action items tracked in the ticket and schedule a 1h blameless postmortem review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

samir: note for TTR metrics: total time to detect ~5m, time to mitigation ~12m, full recovery ~22m. We'll capture exact numbers in the postmortem.

mika: attaching minimal repro in the ticket: a streaming request that sets max_tokens=10000 -> reproduces OOM on small test cluster.

jordan: adding heap snapshots and logs to the ticket.

cs-bot: followups queued: customer emails sent, CS will track replies.

incident-bot: automated followup actions created: [ENG-1977654321-config-guardrails], [OPS-1977654321-fallback-policy], [OBS-1977654321-long-stream-alert].
